name: fridge-door
description: Shared household obligations tracker for Amazon Alexa+, exposed as an MCP server.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fridge-door/shared && npm run build -w @fridge-door/server && npm run build -w @fridge-door/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fridge-door/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fridge-door/server && npm run typecheck -w @fridge-door/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fridge-door/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @fridge-door/server" "npm run dev -w @fridge-door/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @fridge-door/shared && npm run dev -w @fridge-door/server
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @fridge-door/shared && npm run seed -w @fridge-door/server
scripts.samples: npm run build -w @fridge-door/shared && npm run samples -w @fridge-door/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fridge-door/shared && npm run test -w @fridge-door/server
